scope: Synthetic writable emulated NAND only; execute existing guest functions through normal VxWorks shell. Firmware bytes unchanged.
preferred_path: Erase synthetic NAND to0xff, supply a supported chip geometry and functional read/program/erase/OOB/ECC in NFC, then boot. Existing guest initializes BBM, creates VBF and formats DOSFS when their media formats are absent.

automatic_bbm.format_on_missing_branch: FfxBbmCreate0x0062212c checks state1 after mount failure, calls formatter0x0062432c then remounts.

device_configuration.note: Do not map logical DOSFS sector0 to physical NAND page0. BBM and reserved device regions intervene; let genuine FlashFX produce the mapping.

disk_create_api.proof: Arguments r3..r9 placed into local struct by0x005c2248..0x005c2264; FlashFXDiskCreate builds VBF then XBD; FfxDriverAllocatorCreate0x00605f24 checks policy and calls real formatter.

start_length_rounding: FfxDriverDiskAdjust0x00605068 takes erase_block_bytes>>10; start_KiB rounds UP to whole erase blocks, length_KiB rounds DOWN; length0xffffffff means remainder.

guest_shell_commands.note: Select calls based on actual guest state; do not repeat create on an existing mounted disk. The open probe must return a valid fd, then write/read/close it. Inspect exact shell parser and supported open flags before automated execution.

filesystem_payload: system_data.bin is a tar payload, not a preformatted FlashFX image. Copy extracted files into mounted DOSFS using normal guest file APIs after genuine mount; ssm_boot.out should preserve package content hash.
